전도서 6:1.content: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is common among men:

전도서 6:2.content: A man to whom God hath given riches, wealth, and honour, so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth, yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but a stranger eateth it: this is vanity, and it is an evil disease.

전도서 6:3.content: If a man beget an hundred children, and live many years, so that the days of his years be many, and his soul be not filled with good, and also that he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he.

전도서 6:4.content: For he cometh in with vanity, and departeth in darkness, and his name shall be covered with darkness.

전도서 6:5.content: Moreover he hath not seen the sun, nor known any thing: this hath more rest than the other.

전도서 6:6.content: Yea, though he live a thousand years twice told, yet hath he seen no good: do not all go to one place?

전도서 6:7.content: All the labour of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.

전도서 6:8.content: For what hath the wise more than the fool? what hath the poor, that knoweth to walk before the living?

전도서 6:9.content: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire: this is also vanity and vexation of spirit.

전도서 6:10.content: That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.

전도서 6:11.content: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity, what is man the better?

전도서 6:12.content: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life, all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun?
